artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for task 643: orchestrator_mode guard in skill_postflight_update + 3 call site updates

completion_data.completion_summary: Added optional 5th orchestrator_mode parameter to skill_postflight_update() in skill-base.sh that skips update-task-status.sh when true (while preserving extension hooks), and updated the three core skill call sites (researcher, planner, implementer) to pass $orchestrator_mode as the 5th argument.

memory_candidates.content: When adding optional parameters to a bash function for backward compatibility, use the pattern `local param="${N:-default}"` where N is the positional number. This allows callers that omit the parameter to get the old behavior automatically without code changes. Applied in skill_postflight_update() with orchestrator_mode as 5th param defaulting to false.
